title.narrative: Supporting the establishment of integrated agro-industrial parks in Kenya

description.narrative: The Kenya Industrial Transformation Programme (KITP), and the Big Four agenda outlines the country#s strategy for achieving the Vision 2030 goal of becoming an industrial hub. It identifies industrialization opportunities where the country has natural competitive advantages, both regionally and globally to develop the country#s industrial base, including agro-processing as one of the key sectors that can contribute to industrialization and drive Kenya#s economic growth. To this end, the Programme for Country Partnership (PCP) for Kenya focus on three key sectors (textiles, leather and agro processing). It is in this context that the Government of Kenya proposes to create integrated agro industrial parks (IAIPS) to promote investment in agro-industries. The development of IAIPs, is critical for rural development in that it creates a market for agricultural raw materials, as it is established near the raw material sources, allows for integration of small holder farmers, has high potential for job creation and overall provides the requisite infrastructure for agro industry development where entrepreneurs can plug and play.
